what_was_done.action: Fixed `recentEventsForEpic` in `src/lib/reconciler-rules/wave-bead-mismatch.ts` to sort newest-first by Date.parse(timestamp), matching the convention used by sibling Wave 3 rules `stuck-in-stage.ts:recentEpicEvents` and `missed-wave-review-dispatch.ts:recentEpicEvents`.
what_was_done.result: The function now returns the newest N events (per ADR-015 § 3 default + the wlsr.14/15 markers' contract 'cap 10, newest-first'). Pre-fix the function used `slice(Math.max(0, length - cap))` returning oldest-first append order. Post-fix it sorts by `Date.parse(b.timestamp) - Date.parse(a.timestamp)` then slices `[0, cap]`. Updated docblock to cite wlsr.21 and the alignment rationale.
